union:main:b01.raw_sql: SELECT `r`.`user_id` AS `user_id` FROM `ranked` AS `r` JOIN `ods`.`users` AS `u` ON `r`.`user_id` = `u`.`user_id` WHERE `r`.`rn` = 1

ROOT.raw_sql: WITH `aggregated` AS (SELECT `events`.`user_id` AS `user_id`, SUM(`events`.`amount`) AS `total_amount` FROM `ods`.`events` AS `events` GROUP BY `events`.`user_id`), `ranked` AS (SELECT `aggregated`.`user_id` AS `user_id`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `aggregated`.`total_amount` DESC) AS `rn` FROM `aggregated` AS `aggregated`) SELECT `r`.`user_id` AS `user_id` FROM `ranked` AS `r` JOIN `ods`.`users` AS `u` ON `r`.`user_id` = `u`.`user_id` WHERE `r`.`rn` = 1 UNION ALL SELECT `fallback_users`.`user_id` AS `user_id` FROM `ods`.`fallback_users` AS `fallback_users`

cte:aggregated.raw_sql: SELECT `events`.`user_id` AS `user_id`, SUM(`events`.`amount`) AS `total_amount` FROM `ods`.`events` AS `events` GROUP BY `events`.`user_id`

cte:ranked.raw_sql: SELECT `aggregated`.`user_id` AS `user_id`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `aggregated`.`total_amount` DESC) AS `rn` FROM `aggregated` AS `aggregated`
